lines.zh: 我摇摇摆摆地走在沙滩上。
lines.en: I waddle along the beach.
I sway with each step, leaving shallow prints.
I pace along the tide line.
I hop twice and flap my wings.

lines.zh: 我踩着浪尖走了一小段。
lines.en: I ride a wave crest a little way.

lines.zh: 我绕着码头边的木桩走。
lines.en: I walk around the dock posts.
On wet sand my feet make noise.

lines.zh: 我从一群同伴旁边走过。
lines.en: I walk past a flock of my fellows.
I stop and look at the sea.
A few steps further.
I walk downwind.

lines.zh: 我沿着浅水边走，慢悠悠。
lines.en: I stroll along the shallows.
I trot after the withdrawing water.
I go around a rock.
I step into a little pool.
I shake the sand off my feet.
I stand by the waves and stare.
I tilt my head toward the sea.
The wind ruffles my feathers.
I stand on one leg to rest the other.
I open my beak and call.
I wait for the tide to bring food.
My fellows are flying far off.

lines.zh: 我站在木桩上，迎着海风理羽。
lines.en: I stand on a post, preening into the sea wind.
The waves break, one after another.

lines.zh: 我把脖子缩进羽毛，眯起眼。
lines.en: I tuck my neck into my feathers and squint.
Sea wind full of salt.
I keep still and watch the water.

lines.zh: 海风把我的羽毛吹得很乱。
lines.en: Sea wind messes my feathers.
There's a boat far out.

lines.zh: 我的黄嘴张了张，等你的鱼。
lines.en: My yellow bill opens a little, waiting for your fish.

lines.zh: 我仰头，黄嘴对着你的脸。
lines.en: I look up, yellow bill aimed at your face.
I shuffle two steps closer.
Stay still and I'll come near.

lines.zh: 我斜着眼看你，像在掂量食物。
lines.en: I eye you sideways, sizing you up as food.
Fish in your hand and I follow.

lines.zh: 你靴底沾着沙，我认得那味道。
lines.en: Sand clings to your boots; I know that smell.
I called once; did you hear.
I've settled beside you.
Your shadow is good shade.

lines.zh: 我拖着翅膀跑了两步，才飞起来。
lines.en: I run two steps dragging a wing before I get airborne.

lines.zh: 海风一吹，羽毛掉了两根。
lines.en: Two feathers come loose in the sea wind.
I flap back away.

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，又站稳在沙上。
lines.en: I lurch once, then steady myself on the sand.
I walk a few steps crooked.
The flock has taken off.

lines.zh: 我钻进礁石缝，只露一只眼。
lines.en: I squeeze into a rock crevice, one eye showing.

lines.zh: 我的一根飞羽折了，垂在身侧。
lines.en: One flight feather is bent and hangs at my side.
My wing gives, then holds me up again.

lines.zh: 我的翅尖垂下来，飞不太稳。
lines.en: A wingtip droops; I can barely fly straight.
Fish! I see fish!
I'll come over at once.
Hold it up; I can reach.

lines.zh: 那条鱼还在甩尾，我的嘴张开了。
lines.en: The fish is still flapping; my bill opens.
Don't pull it back all at once.
I smell that fishiness.

lines.zh: 我踮起脚，嘴尖离鱼只差一点。
lines.en: I rise on my toes, bill tip a hair from the fish.
Just a small piece is enough.
The others have all turned to look.
I'll follow you a while.
I flap away with a squawk.
I'm light; a bump doesn't hurt.
You crowded me and I backed off.

lines.zh: 我从你两腿中间挤过，翅膀蹭到你。
lines.en: I squeeze between your legs, wing brushing you.
I flap twice to steady.
A puff of sand kicks up.
In the sea wind, I hop half a step aside.

lines.zh: 碰撞声惊起了几只同伴。
lines.en: The bump startles a few of my fellows.

lines.zh: 沙滩上的鱼腥味，跟着你走。
lines.en: The smell of fish on this beach follows you.
I return to my spot.

lines.zh: 另一只白鸟落在我旁边。
lines.en: Another white bird lands beside me.
We walk the tide line side by side.
Its call is louder than mine.
We both dip our heads for food.
There's an old nest site on the rocks.

lines.zh: 我把最好的一块推给它。
lines.en: I push the best piece toward it.
The sea wind blows us together.

lines.zh: 我们一同飞起来，又落下。
lines.en: We fly up together and land.
The tide withdraws; we follow.

lines.zh: 天色暗下来，我们还没走。
lines.en: The light fades and we're still here.

lines.zh: 我叼着那块面包，甩掉上面的沙。
lines.en: I pick up the bread and shake the sand off.

lines.zh: 我啄了两下，硬得啄不动。
lines.en: I peck twice; it is too hard to break.

lines.zh: 我仰头，把那块鱼骨咽下去。
lines.en: I tip my head back and swallow the fish bone.
It's stuck in my throat.
I drop it back on the sand.
I carry it around.
A fellow tried; I flew off.
I reach the shore fish first.

lines.zh: 我叼起贝壳，往石头上砸。
lines.en: I pick up a shell and smash it on a stone.
I hide it behind a post.
There's food over there.
I see it; it's fish.
I turn and head that way.
The tide is coming in.
I've fixed on that spot.

lines.zh: 我拍翅离地，绕着你转半圈。
lines.en: I beat my wings up and circle half around you.
Alright, I'll fly over.

lines.zh: 我收了收翅，朝你那边踱步。
lines.en: I settle my wings and pace toward you.
I cut around in front of it.
This distance isn't far.
If there's fish in your hand, I follow.
I tilt my head at it.

lines.zh: 我收着翅膀，小步靠过去。
lines.en: I fold my wings and creep closer in small steps.
I walk a few steps nearer.

lines.zh: 浪一拍岸，我就往前挪一步。
lines.en: Each wave hits the shore, and I take one step forward.

lines.zh: 我歪头盯着你的手，等它松开。
lines.en: I tilt my head at your hand, waiting for it to open.
It rests on the sand.

lines.zh: 我飞低，影子从你肩上掠过。
lines.en: I fly low, my shadow sweeping over your shoulder.
Just a tiny bit more.

lines.zh: 我停在你三步外，脖子压低。
lines.en: I stop three steps away, neck low.
One peck and I've got it.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀横着扫过你的膝盖。
lines.en: My wing sweeps sideways across your knee.
I grab it and shake.
This strength is only for snatching food.
I kick off and fly away.
One tug and it lets go.
Sand splashes my face.

lines.zh: 我扑下，爪子在你头顶一抓。
lines.en: I dive and rake my claws over your head.
I run off with it.
These little quarrels happen often.
I fly in from over the sea.
I land on the beach and fold my wings.
A seagull, standing at the tide line.
I land with a flock of fellows.
The sea wind is strong; I hold firm.
I call out, hailing the flock.
I descend along the dock.
I land on the breaking surf.
I know this beach.

lines.zh: 我从礁石上落下，收翅站住。
lines.en: I drop from the rock and fold my wings.
My feathers were singed and curled.
I fall from the air onto the sand.

lines.zh: 羽毛湿透了，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Soaked feathers; I can't stay afloat.
The blast throws me up.
The arrow grazed me; a few feathers fell.
The light leaves me dizzy.

lines.zh: 找不到吃的，我站都站不稳。
lines.en: No food; I can barely stand.
At the thunder, we all scatter.
No sea wind here to ride.
